consent.title: Wo Penee
consent.paragraph1: Yɛato nsa afrɛ wo sɛ wonwie adwuma ho ahoboa nhwehwɛmu bi denam MeritLense so. Wo nkyɛmu yɛ wo ara wo pɛ, na sɛ wotoa so a, na wode di adanseɛ sɛ wo ara wopɛ sɛ wokyɛ mu.
consent.paragraph2: Yɛbɛyɛ wo mmuae, wo nne ne wo nipa a woyɛ ho nsɛm ho adwuma de ayɛ nhwehwɛmu yi, na amanneɛbɔ a ɛbɛfiri mu aba no, yɛde bɛma adwumawura anaa ahyehyɛdeɛ a ɔbisaeɛ no. MeritLense nsi gyinaeɛ a ɛfa adwuma a wɔde bɛma wo ho — adwumawura no na ɔsi.
consent.namePlaceholder: Wo din nni hɔ — mesrɛ wo, frɛ mmoa kuo no
consent.agreeLabel: Mepene sɛ mɛkyɛ nhwehwɛmu yi mu na wɔayɛ me nsɛm ho adwuma sɛdeɛ wɔakyerɛkyerɛ mu wɔ atifi hɔ no.
consent.errorGeneric: Biribi kɔɔ basaa berɛ a yɛrekora wo penee so. Mesrɛ wo, san sɔ hwɛ.

privacy.title: Kokoamsɛm Ho Nkaeɛ
privacy.paragraph1: MeritLense boaboa wo mmuae a wode w'ano anaa nkyerɛwee de maeɛ (a nne a wɔkyere ne nkyerɛwee ka ho sɛ wode wo nne buaa a) ano, mfonini a wɔtwa de hwɛ sɛ wo ara ne wo, ne nsɛnkyerɛnne, akontaa ne nsunsuansoɔ foforɔ a yɛn AI nhwehwɛmu yi firi wo mmuae mu, na ɛyɛ ho adwuma. Sɛ wo nhyiamu no wɔ video nsɛmmisa a ɛkɔ so seesei a, wɔnkyere frɛ no ankasa — wo mmuae a wode w'ano maeɛ nko ara na wɔkyerɛw de hwehwɛ mu.
privacy.paragraph2: Yɛde nsɛm yi di dwuma de hwɛ sɛ wo ara ne wo, de yɛ wo adwuma ho ahoboa nhwehwɛmu, de hwehwɛ wo mmuae ne wo ahoɔden mu, na yɛde yɛ wo nhwehwɛmu amanneɛbɔ ne, sɛ ɛfata a, adanseɛ krataa.
privacy.paragraph3: Nhwehwɛmu yi fã bi de AI ne mfiri a ɛyɛ ne ho adwuma di dwuma de kyerɛw, kyerɛ aseɛ na ɛhwehwɛ wo mmuae mu. Nsunsuansoɔ no yɛ nsɛm a ɛboa gyinaesie, ɛnyɛ gyinaeɛ a etwa toɔ — adwumawura anaa ahyehyɛdeɛ a ɔtoo nsa frɛɛ wo kɔɔ nhwehwɛmu yi mu no na ɔwɔ asɛdeɛ a ɛwɔ adwuma ho gyinaeɛ biara so.
privacy.paragraph4: MeritLense ntɔn wo nsɛm. Ɔsom adwumayɛfoɔ a wɔama wɔn kwan (te sɛ nne-kɔ-nkyerɛwee, nkyerɛaseɛ ne AI nhwehwɛmu adwumayɛfoɔ) betumi ayɛ wo nsɛm ho adwuma kodu baabi a ehia sɛ wɔde saa nhwehwɛmu som yi bɛma nko ara, na wɔbɛbɔ ho ban yie. Yɛde wo nsunsuansoɔ nso ma adwumawura anaa adwumakuo a ɔbisaa nhwehwɛmu yi.
privacy.paragraph5: Yɛkora wo nsɛm sɛdeɛ MeritLense nsɛm a wɔkora ho nhyehyɛeɛ teɛ.
privacy.ackLabel: Medi adanseɛ sɛ makenkan Kokoamsɛm Ho Nkaeɛ yi na mate aseɛ, na megye tom sɛ wɔbɛyɛ me ankasa me nsɛm, a video, nne, nkyerɛwee ne nipa a meyɛ ho nsɛm ka ho, ho adwuma ama botaeɛ a wɔakyerɛkyerɛ mu wɔ atifi hɔ no.
privacy.errorGeneric: Biribi kɔɔ basaa berɛ a yɛrekora wo gyedie so. Mesrɛ wo, san sɔ hwɛ.

cookie.title: Yɛbu wo kokoamsɛm
cookie.body: Yɛde cookies a ehia ne nneɛma a ɛte saa sie nneɛma na woatumi atena mu na wɛbsaet no ayɛ adwuma. Sɛ woma yɛn kwan a, yɛde cookies a ɛyɛ nhwehwɛmu ne aguadeɛ ho a ɛnhia nso bɛdi dwuma; ɛnnɛ, baako mpo nyɛ adwuma. Wobɛtumi asesa wo paw berɛ biara wɔ Cookie nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛwɔ krataafa no ase.

howItWorks: Nsɛmmisa no firi yɛn nsɛmmisa korabea a wɔapene so (Borɔfo ne Arabik) mu.
Wɔkyerɛ aseɛ kɔ kasa a woapaw no mu ne ho.
Wobɛtumi atie nsɛmmisa no wɔ kasa mmienu no nyinaa mu.
Wobɛtumi de nne anaa nkyerɛwee abua, sɛdeɛ kasa no mmoa teɛ.
language.audioSupportBody: Nne wɔ hɔ wɔ Borɔfo ne kasa pii a yɛboa mu. Sɛ nne nni hɔ wɔ wo kasa mu a, wobɛtumi akenkan nsɛmmisa no na woakyerɛw mmuae.
